error.access_redirect: Umami redirected to a login page (HTTP 302). If it is behind Cloudflare Access, set a service token in the plugin settings.
error.bad_json: Umami sent a response that could not be read.
error.not_configured: Set an API key or login in the plugin settings. Click to open them.
error.not_started: The request could not be started.
error.two_factor: This account uses two-factor authentication, which the plugin cannot complete. Use an account without it.
error.unauthorized: Umami rejected the credentials. Check them in the plugin settings.

api_key.description: API key from Settings → API keys in Umami, self-hosted or Cloud. Leave empty to log in with a username and password instead. Stored in plain text in your Noctalia config.
api_key.label: API Key

api_url.description: Umami Cloud: https://api.umami.is/v1. Self-hosted: your instance URL followed by /api, for example https://umami.example.com/api.
api_url.label: API URL

cf_access_client_id.description: Only for Umami behind Cloudflare Access. Create it under Zero Trust → Access controls → Service credentials, then add a Service Auth policy to the application. See the README.
cf_access_client_id.label: Cloudflare Access Client ID

cf_access_client_secret.description: Cloudflare Access service token Client Secret, shown only once when the token is created. Stored in plain text in your Noctalia config.
cf_access_client_secret.label: Cloudflare Access Client Secret

password.description: Self-hosted login password, used only when no API key is set. Stored in plain text in your Noctalia config.
password.label: Password

refresh_seconds.description: How often to fetch visitor counts and stats.
refresh_seconds.label: Refresh Interval (seconds)

show_environment.description: Show the Environment card on a website's dashboard page.
show_environment.label: Show Environment

show_location.description: Show the Location card on a website's dashboard page.
show_location.label: Show Location

show_pages.description: Show the Pages card on a website's dashboard page.
show_pages.label: Show Pages

show_sources.description: Show the Sources card on a website's dashboard page.
show_sources.label: Show Sources

username.description: Self-hosted login username, used only when no API key is set.
username.label: Username

tooltip.online: {count} visitors online now. Click for the dashboard, right-click to refresh.
